home.title: Out of the oven by eight
home.lede: A neighborhood bakery opening July 2026 — bread, pastry, and a team that bakes it with care.
body: Long ferments and laminated layers, the way they're done in Paris. Cardamom, orange blossom, and sesame, the way they're done at home.
Louma is named for Milla's sister. It's a small place with a big idea: that a bakery run well can be a place where everyone belongs.
home.missionLine: Built so everyone at the counter belongs.
home.newsletterBody: One note when the doors open. Nothing else.

menu.title: The menu
menu.lede: Baked through the morning, sold until it's gone. Prices and items are placeholders until opening.
menu.allergenNote: Our kitchen handles wheat, dairy, eggs, nuts, and sesame. We can't guarantee any item is free of allergens. Ask us and we'll tell you what's in it.

story.title: Named for Louma
story.lede: How a sister's name became a bakery on Wilshire.
body: Milla Ghandour started Louma with one belief: good bread and good work belong to everyone.
Many of the people who make Louma run have intellectual or developmental differences. The bakery exists, in part, to show that done right, that's a strength — not an exception.

founder.name: Milla Ghandour
body: Milla grew up baking with her sister Louma. The bakery carries her name and, with it, a promise about who it's for.
She spent years in professional kitchens before building one she'd want to work in — high standards, fair pay, and a door open to people most places overlook.

mission.title: The work, and who does it
mission.lede: Inclusive employment isn't a program here. It's how the bakery is built.
body: We hire, train, and pay fairly. We design the work so people can do it well and grow.
If you'd like to support the mission, you can give — every dollar goes to training and wages.

values.title: Real jobs
values.body: Paid, skilled work with room to grow — not busywork, not a photo op.

values.title: Designed to fit
values.body: We shape roles and training around how people actually learn and work best.

values.title: High standards
values.body: Inclusion and excellence aren't a trade-off. The bread proves it every morning.

mission.donateBody: Every dollar goes straight to training and wages. No overhead, no middleman.

catering.title: Catering & wholesale
catering.lede: Bread and pastry for offices, events, and shops nearby.
body: Tell us the date, the headcount, and what you're after. We'll send back what we can do.

steps.title: Tell us
steps.body: Send the date, headcount, and a rough idea. The form below is enough to start.

steps.title: We propose
steps.body: We reply within two business days with options and a quote.

steps.title: We bake
steps.body: Pickup on Wilshire or delivery nearby, fresh that morning.

careers.title: Work at Louma
careers.lede: We're hiring bakers, counter staff, and trainers ahead of opening.
body: No bakery experience required for every role — a willingness to learn and show up does.
Tell us a little about yourself and we'll be in touch.

roles.title: Training Track
roles.body: Our flagship role. A paid, supported path into baking and counter work, built for people with intellectual or developmental differences. No experience needed.

roles.title: Baker
roles.body: Mix, shape, and bake breads and pastries through the morning. Experience helps; attitude matters more.

roles.title: Counter & Service
roles.body: Greet the neighborhood, run the register, keep the case full and the room warm.

roles.title: Job Coach / Trainer
roles.body: Support and grow the Training Track team on the floor. Background in IDD support preferred.

visit.title: Visit
visit.lede: On Wilshire in Santa Monica. Opening July 2026.
body: Parking on the street and in the lot behind the building. The door's the one with the face on it.
A short walk from the Metro E Line; bike racks out front.

notFound.title: Lost your way?
notFound.lede: We couldn't find that page. Let's get you back to something warm.
